abstract: Pediatric pelvic neoplasms, although relatively uncommon, are often difficult to evaluate and characterize with imaging, due to their overlapping appearances. This article discusses key clinical features and imaging findings that help limit the differential diagnosis of pediatric pelvic neoplasms. Testicular, ovarian, uterine, and bladder masses are included in addition to sacrococcygeal teratoma.
abstract_ja: 小児の骨盤内腫瘍は比較的稀であるが、画像上の所見が重なりやすいため評価や性状診断が難しいことが多い。本稿では、鑑別診断の範囲を絞り込むのに役立つ主な臨床像と画像所見について述べる。精巣、卵巣、子宮、膀胱の腫瘤に加え、仙尾部奇形腫も取り上げる。
